title: Allah Orders Justice, Charity and Forbids Oppression
body:
O Arabs! A warning for you to say, “Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmani ‘r-Raheem. A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani ‘rrajeem.” You have forgotten to say, “Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmani ‘r-Raheem,” that there is no power except through
Allah Almighty, laa hawla wa la quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Adheem. Allah, Allah. Laa hawla wa la
quwatta illa billah.
You like to be addressed, “O Arabs! O nation of Arabs.” what you say is wrong upon wrong as there is no
nation of Arabs, there is the nation of the Beloved (s). You have forgotten everything. O Arabs! At the end of
1332, since then you have been working with tasteless things you have fallen into a trap that you don't know
how to get out of. Your native language is the language of the Holy Qur`an, but there is no understanding left
with you, not with your kings or presidents, general scholars or the public majority. The Holy Qur`an is
everything!
••••• •••••• ••••• ••••••• •••••• ••• •••••• •••••••••
wa laa ratbin wa laa yaabisin illa fee kitaabin mubeen. Nor (is there) anything fresh or dry (green or
withered), but is (inscribed) in a record clear
(to those who can read). (al-An`am, 6:59)

••••••• •••••• •••••••••••• •••••••••
wa kulla shay'in fassalnahu tafseelaa. For clearly, most clearly, have We spelled out everything! (al-Isra:17:12)
Allah (swt) did not leave Holy Qur`an to be a book that is not understood, not in the past or the present or
the future, but pity upon you. The first responsibility is upon you since your language is Arabic. As if you do
not belief the ancient Words of Allah (swt):
••••• •••••• •••••••••••
Feehi ayatun bayyinatun. Full of clear messages. (Al-Imran, 3:97)
•••• •••••••••• ••• ••••••••• ••• ••••••
ma farratna fee alkitabi min shay’in. No single thing have We neglected in Our Decree. (Al-An'am, 6:38)
Anyone who would like to learn or understand, let him read the Holy Qur`an to find his way to the Truth or
the righteous way. Today Arabs are killing each other. Are you not Arabs? Why aren’t you saying? O
Presidents! O Kings! Why are you killing your nations and people in your countries? That is forbidden, but
you are doing things that make Allah angry with you and make Shaytan happy with you! Your current state
pleases Shaytan, but Allah (swt) is not pleased or happy with the current situation and what is coming
tomorrow. Shaytan is very happy and joyful because the Arabs are fighting one another, although they are
Muslims and their fighting is forbidden, as Allah (swt) conveyed to His servants through Prophet (s):
•• •••• •• •••• •• •• •• •••
Inna Allah qad ‘a`eta kul zee haqqen haqqah. Verily Allah has given to each his right.
It is as if there is an exclusive right reserved for one man, who is fighting for his rights, but rights are for their
owners. One of them is called “Saleh” and his deeds are not saleh (good). Allah has ordered his servants to
give each his right. However, Saleh is saying, “My right is to be president over the people of Yemen, and
Yemen and its citizens belong to me, and I will rule Yemen until my death!” Who gave you such rights? Did
Allah give you the right to be a tyrant over the people of Yemen, to kill and oppress them? Who gave you that
fatwa (legal ruling) or opportunity? How could this be the state of Islam?
O Arabs! Don’t you understand Holy Quran? If the president has rights they must be kept, but when he is

president, people have rights over him as well, and he must give each of the people of Yemen their rights! But
he is thinking only about his own rights. Yemen is not only for one person but for all the people of Yemen; for
each a share in the land of Yemen. Why are you riding on top of them? Why? Give each one his right! Give
them more and keep justice amongst them. Allah (swt) said in His Holy Qur`an and all Friday preachers end
their sermons with the holy verse:
••••• •••••• •••••••• ••••••••••• ••••••••••••• ••••••••• ••• •••••••••• ••••••••• •••• ••••••••••• •••••••••••• •••••••••••
•••••••••• ••••••••••• ••••••••••••
Inna Allaha yamuru bi ‘l`adli waalihsani waeetai thee al-qurba wayanha `ani al-fahshai wal-munkari walbaghyi ya`ithukum la`allakum tathakkaroon. Behold! God enjoins justice and the doing of good, and
generosity towards [one's] fellow-men, and He forbids all that is shameful and all that runs counter to
reason, as well as envy, [and] He exhorts you [repeatedly] so that you might bear [all this] in mind. (AnNahl:16:90)
O Saleh! O Saleh! Your name is Saleh (“goodness”), but your deeds are not good. Be just, don’t be an
oppressor! Be a protector of the people and families, and keep their rights. You have been ordered to obey
Allah’s Words and He has ordered justice. Had you done good, your people wouldn’t have risen against you,
but you are like Qaroon, you have saved treasures, billions in banks inside your country. Why didn’t you do
good? The people of Yemen are poor and you have squandered billions, for what? Allah (swt) has ordered you
to do justice to your people and kinfolk. Ihsaan (moral excellence) is reflected in the famous Arabic wisdom
that humans are slaves/servants to goodness/charity:
••••••• •••• •••••••
Al insaan `abeed ‘al ‘ihsaan.
You are Arabs; don’t you understand these words? The same matter applies to the tyrants of Sham, Egypt and
Libya. For what are you being tyrants? May Allah (swt) bring them down and fight them! Allah is ordering
charity; where is your charity? Arabs are famous for their generosity, as per the famous Arabic saying:
••••• •• ••• •••••
Al karam min shiyam al-Arab.

O Saleh! If you are Arab, why didn’t you show your generosity to the people and distribute what Allah
generous brought upon you from millions and billions? Why didn’t you spend upon the poor people of
Yemen? Had they been comfortable and happy with you, they wouldn’t have risen against you, but you have
done what Qaroon and tyrants of old did, until the people have risen against you and proclaimed, “Leave
Saleh, leave!” You are the reason and your deeds come back to you. You are the reason that the people of
Yemen have risen against you, protesting in the streets and you are using weapons against the oppressed. Is
this your character? Is this justice, humanity, piety and faith? Are you not afraid that lighting will fall upon
you and strike you from Heaven? Even if there were no clouds, the sky can strike you from an unknown place
and kill you without killing the people of Yemen. It is a shame on you! Allah has ordered justice and charity.
Justice, justice, justice! And He raises the stations of people.
O Tyrants of Arabs and All Nations! If you don’t listen, follow and obey Allah, Who ordered justice and
charity, He will crush you here and in your graves at least seventy times! Allah Almighty orders Justice.
Allahu Akbaru al-Akbar! Allah Almighty, You are Subhaan, You are Sultan! Your order is on our heads, O
Allah!
Allah Almighty ordered us to do justice and charity, starting with our close ones. Also, Allah forbids
oppression. Repent to Allah, O presidents from east to west. Leave what is forbidden and return to the good
and right way. Arabs have been known in the past as the people of goodness; you have this character. It is a
character of Arabs to be charitable.
O Presidents! You have followed Shaytan and abandoned the law of Allah. Allah forbids oppression
anywhere, and in Egypt, Libya and Arab countries oppression has filled the world. You left what is
permissible and have done what is forbidden.
•••••••••• ••••••• ••••••••
walathikru Allahi akbaru. And the remembrance of God is indeed the greatest [good]. (al-'Ankabut, 29:45)
Instead of the remembrance of Allah, you have taken those groups who sing for you and you drink alcohol
and then dance. Is this your Islam, O Arabs? Allah is warning/advising you so that you may remember. Allah
(swt) is warning you! Allah has forbidden oppression and the remembrance of Allah, dhikrullah, is the
greatest good deed. Why aren’t you remembering Allah in the mosques, He has given you people of Hijaz,

Wahhabis and Salafis and others? You come against dhikrullah, but Allah al-Haqq (swt) says, “Remembrance
of Allah is the greatest, so say, ‘Laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Laa ilaaha illaLlah!’”
When the blessed companion, Sa`ad ibn Abi Waqqas (r) and his army walked over the Euphrates they were
all saying, “Laa ilaaha illa-LlahLaa ilaaha illa-Llah.” They marched over the Euphrates and reached Persia,
and when the Persian soldiers saw that, they said, Behold! Those people walking on the surface of water are
not human, they are beings we don’t know. Retreat, retreat, retreat, or you will be finished!”
They were able to walk on water with the power of dhikrullah, which you stand against, saying it is
innovation, bid`ah! Kill whoever claims dhikrullah is innovation! May Allah make them the lowest among
people, who fight the servants of Allah who recite, “Allah, Allah. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah.” Those who say dhikr is
innovation, you got that fatwa from Shaytan, but your time is soon coming to an end! Allah Almighty will
make you vanish from existence altogether!
Allah, Allah. Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah astaghfirullah. Repentance and forgiveness, O Allah!
O Arabs! O Arabs! Imaan came through you and has reached all nations through the enthusiasm of your
fathers and grandfathers, and now you want Muslims to go back and deviate from the way your pious fathers
and grandfathers took? There is no goodness in you, until you return to the Truth! Allah orders justice and
charity. Until you return to the order of Allah (swt), this is a divine warning that He will not leave anyone of
you!
O Heedless Arabs and Others! Come back and repent to Allah! O Allah! Forgive us and send us a king to fight
in Your Way!
Bi hurmati ‘l-habib bi hurmati ‘l-Fatihah.
My Arabic is little but nevermind, edit and publish it. These realities we have related to you. O Allah, forgive
us!
Fatihah.
